text: Two translucent white plastic wash bottles stand upright in the centre-left of the frame, on or beside a white and aluminium linear rail/track that runs diagonally across a light benchtop. Each bottle has a red closure with an angled spout; the nearer bottle's red spout points right, and the farther one's spout connects to a black flexible tube curving to the right. The nearer bottle has a green band around its body and appears to hold clear liquid; the farther bottle also appears to contain clear liquid. A small white knob/cap sits on the rail behind them. At upper left are a white instrument with a display and another white bottle, plus a white tray. The right half shows a dark grey panelled surface with pale flecks.
